description: Find a piano MIDI for a song, transpose it to white keys only (C major / A minor), split it into its repeated parts (riff, verse, chorus loops) as separate MIDI files, and save them in an iCloud Drive folder named `<song>-midi` for piano learning on iPad with midee.app. Use when the user asks for piano MIDI files of a song, white-keys or C major versions, song parts to learn one by one, or MIDI for midee.
